title: P08: asyncio.to_thread 桥接
body:
# P08 · 异步服务里跑同步推理

FastAPI/异步 worker 中不要直接在事件循环里跑重计算。用 `asyncio.to_thread` 包一层。

## 注释
- 代码里带有 **【优先课注释】** 与分段说明，先读注释再跑。

starterFiles.p08_main.py:
# 【优先课注释】PyTorch
# 课题：P08: asyncio.to_thread 桥接
# 建议：先通读注释 → 运行看输出 → 改一处参数再跑 → 对照书本加深。
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- 导入依赖 ---
import asyncio
import time

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

model = nn.Linear(4, 2)
model.eval()


# --- 函数 sync_infer：读参数与返回值，想清楚谁调用它 ---
def sync_infer(batch: list[list[float]]) -> list[list[float]]:
    # pretend this is heavy
    time.sleep(0.2)
    with torch.no_grad():
        x = torch.tensor(batch, dtype=torch.float32)
        return model(x).tolist()


# --- 异步函数 handle_request：注意 await 点，勿在此写阻塞 IO ---
async def handle_request(batch: list[list[float]]) -> list[list[float]]:
    return await asyncio.to_thread(sync_infer, batch)


# --- 异步函数 main：注意 await 点，勿在此写阻塞 IO ---
async def main() -> None:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    a, b = await asyncio.gather(
        handle_request([[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]]),
        handle_request([[0.5, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2]]),
    )
    print("results", a, b)
    print(f"elapsed={time.perf_counter() - t0:.2f}s")


# --- 脚本入口：从这里开始执行 ---
if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
